description: Motion correction finer than whole pixels: subpixel shifts on a texture moved by half pixels, piecewise rigid correction (patches) of a texture whose quadrants move apart, and sessions aligned with a rotation, whose ROIs land where the ground truth puts them; and Quicky's shape detection finding somata that are never active; run again with skipCompleted, the sessions it already corrected are left out. make_data.py writes the recordings and the steps from the ground truth.
